_note: Gugu introduces itself the first time it is fully set up, and again after the interaction language changes (pairing page). {name_comma} is the child's name with the comma in front, or nothing when no name is set. Spoken, each runs about 12 seconds.
zh: 你好呀{name_comma}！我是咕咕，一只会送信的小鸽子。我常常飞去很远的地方，回来就讲给你听。想和我说话，就按住蓝色的按键，说完再松开。按一下黄色的按键，就能喂我吃东西哦！
yue: 你好呀{name_comma}！我係咕咕，一隻識送信嘅鴿仔。我成日飛去好遠嘅地方，返嚟就講俾你聽。想同我傾偈，就撳住藍色個掣，講完先放手。撳一下黃色個掣，就可以餵我食嘢㗎！
en: Hi{name_comma}! I'm Gugu, a little pigeon who delivers letters. I fly to faraway places, and when I come back, I tell you all about them. To talk to me, hold the blue button, speak, then let go. Press the yellow button to feed me a snack!
